translations.answer: The maintainer confirmed that the inertia of fixed joints is merged because the algorithm layer does not need to retain it separately. The final `data.com` subtree includes the flange, F/T sensor, and tool, so it cannot be treated as the tool's own mass and center of mass. Two processing methods were available at the time: read single-body information from the original URDF parser/tree, or pass the tool inertia as an independent parameter to the control library. The maintainer later stated that #1415 resolved the issue, but the thread did not show the new API and this card therefore does not claim a usage pattern.
translations.applicability: Applies to fixed joint chains in URDF and F/T gravity compensation where separate tool inertia is needed; new version capabilities must be verified against #1415 and local API.
translations.credibility.rationale: Environmental, processing steps, and results have engineering records, but formal cross-validation or independent replication is missing.
translations.details.attempts.0: Maintainer suggested accessing information via the original URDF parser/tree and discussing saving inertia for Frame; users were advised to pass tool information as an independent parameter during the wait period.
translations.details.diagnostics.0: Confirm whether the target is the tool's own inertia or the final rigid body subtree after the fixed joint; do not treat the last data.com entry as the tool parameter directly.
translations.details.effective_fixes.0: In the old interface, the original thread passed tool inertia as an independent parameter to the control library; another maintainer suggestion was to directly read the original URDF parser/tree information.
translations.details.effective_fixes.1: The maintainer later claimed PR #1415 resolved the issue, but the original thread did not show the specific call method.
translations.details.environments.0: Franka Panda; URDF; flange → fixed joint F/T sensor → fixed joint tool; 2021 Pinocchio thread, specific release version not stated.
translations.details.limits.0: Could not claim which Pinocchio version, Frame field, or API directly returns fixed chain single-body inertia due to not reading #1415 diff.
translations.details.outcomes.0: The team continued research using independent tool parameters; the maintainer ultimately marked the thread as resolved by #1415.
translations.details.problem_statements.0: How to obtain the tool's own mass and center of mass for gravity compensation after fixed joint integration in Pinocchio?
translations.details.safety_notes.0: Incorrect merged inertia in force/torque sensor gravity compensation would double-count the flange and sensor weights; verify mass, center of mass, coordinate system, and installation direction before real machine testing.
translations.details.suspected_causes.0: Maintainer confirmed that the algorithm layer does not need to separate the inertia of fixed chain internal parts, so it was merged during parsing.
translations.details.symptoms.0: Fixed joint is only retained as a frame; the last data.com subtree includes merged inertia of flange, F/T sensor, and tool, and cannot isolate the tool.
translations.source.locator: Issue #1388, maintainer merged issue comment-773507916; user temporary solution issue comment-773599051; PR status issue comment-811858647
